summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. 53/53 pytest tests passed (100%) — 35 iteration-1 regression tests still pass plus 18 new tests covering all 6 new features: (1) Mongo persistence via /api/audit/ai_outputs and /api/audit/logs endpoints; (2) Vector RAG retrieval — /api/chat/ask returns audit_id + retrieved_sources and persists to Mongo with citations; (3) XGBoost-blended NBA opportunity scores in [0,100] with confidence in [0,1]; (4) Holt-Winters forecast — 8 weekly points with sensible non-zero forecast_rate (~21-22%) and valid CI bands (low <= rate <= high); (5) Bedrock SSE streaming — /api/chat/ask_stream returns text/event-stream with both `event: meta` and `event: delta` arriving within timeout; (6) PDF export — /api/export/exec_brief_pdf returns valid application/pdf (>3KB without narrative, >4KB with narrative, %PDF magic). Briefing and exec narrative both now return audit_id and persist to Mongo. Total wall-time 208s including 4 LLM round-trips.
critical_code_review_comments: Forecast confidence_low is clamped to 0 across all 8 horizons while the band stays wide (~70 high). For a 17% conversion baseline, a 0-70 band is too loose to be actionable — consider tightening with a smaller alpha or applying historical-variance scaling to confidence intervals.

/api/audit/ai_outputs currently exposes a flat 'payload' field containing the full LLM markdown answer; for a chat with 6 citations and ~3-5KB markdown this can balloon. Consider adding a 'payload_summary' / truncated answer field and a separate full-payload endpoint to keep the audit list response light.

PDF endpoint accepts include_narrative but does not expose any size limit or caching — a malicious caller could trigger repeated 30s LLM round-trips. Add basic rate limiting and/or in-memory caching of the latest narrative for ~5 min.
Streaming /api/chat/ask_stream lacks a heartbeat — if Bedrock stalls >30s, intermediate proxies may drop the connection silently. Emit a `: keep-alive` comment line every 10s as a safety net.
Mongo collection ai_outputs has no TTL index; auditing data will grow unboundedly. Add a TTL index on created_at (e.g., 90 days) or document the retention policy.
test_credentials: Not required — open demo mode, no auth on backend endpoints
seed_data_creation: No external seed. Iteration 2 lifespan creates: ai_outputs (populated by AI calls during tests — 3 chat + 2 briefing + 2 narrative entries), audit_logs (empty), rag_chunks (295 docs built at startup). Source data unchanged: 50 HCPs, 18 reps, 200 interactions, 34 conversions, 14 source tables.
